annotations.title: Draft a synthetic panel from a description

description: Turns a plain description of an audience ("100 Midwest senior citizens") into a panel spec: filters on Census and General Social Survey fields, a size, and stated shares for traits with no data behind them (assumed). Saves nothing. Show the person the spec and assumedNotes, then pass the spec to prism_panels_create. poolSize is how many people in the population sample match.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.
